announcements.headline: Voluntary Liquidation following the General Meeting
announcements.insight: Zytronic enters members' voluntary liquidation following the June General Meeting. Shareholders will receive a return of capital as the company ceases operations.

announcements.headline: Circular - June 2026
announcements.insight: Zytronic proceeds with its Members’ Voluntary Liquidation. The June circular convenes a general meeting following the May update, marking a key step in returning capital to shareholders.

announcements.headline: Issuing a Circular convening a General Meeting for the Members’ Voluntary Liquidation of the Company
announcements.insight: Zytronic is convening a general meeting for members' voluntary liquidation, following the May update. This signals the final stage of winding up the company and returning capital to shareholders.

announcements.headline: Update on the Liquidation and Return to Shareholders
announcements.insight: Zytronic is undergoing liquidation with funds returning to shareholders. This marks the end of the company as a going concern.
